mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ds_feedback_event (id, tenant_id, user_id, source, session_id, message_id, solved, reason_code, payload_json, free_text, recovery_action_taken, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{source}, #{sessionId}, #{messageId}, #{solved}, #{reasonCode}, #{payloadJson}, #{freeText}, #{recoveryActionTaken}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE ds_feedback_event SET solved = #{entity.solved}, reason_code = #{entity.reasonCode}, payload_json = #{entity.payloadJson}, free_text = #{entity.freeText}, recovery_action_taken = #{entity.recoveryActionTaken}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{entity.id} AND tenant_id = #{entity.tenantId}
